links.comparator_used: No alternative arm; agent classifications were compared against blinded clinician ratings of 400 transcripts as the reference standard
links.outcome: Detection and escalation of actionable suicide risk (sensitivity, specificity, PPV, agreement with clinicians)
links.effect: Weighted sensitivity 93.2% (95% CI 88.8-97.8%); specificity 99.7% (99.6-99.8%); PPV 80.7% (74.3-86.5%); four-level agreement 95.5% (weighted kappa 0.72); no clinician-rated Immediate-risk conversation completely missed
links.tradeoff: About 19% of escalated conversations were not confirmed by clinicians as warranting escalation (PPV 80.7%). A small number of Non-Immediate-risk conversations were under-classified by one severity level. Risk was detected only when spontaneously disclosed.
links.quote: Among conversations clinicians judged to contain actionable suicide risk, the safety agent correctly escalated 93.2% of them (95% CI, 88.8–97.8%; weighted sensitivity).

design_hint: suicide-risk detection and escalation agent with clinician validation
